title: Moving an Owner Plan from Automatic Draft to Direct Bill — Installment Payment Plans Desk Reference
content:
**Subject.** Under the **Installment Payment Plans**, the named insured of an Owner Auto Policy term billed on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan may ask to stop the automatic drafts and pay by bill. When the move falls when at least one installment has been invoiced and two or more are not yet invoiced, and neither the installment invoice that the payment most recently returned on the plan had paid nor its next installment invoice, if already issued, has two or more payments posted against it (a payment recorded against an invoice not counting when it is the returned payment itself or a makeup referencing it), and the owner term backs at most one certificate, the representative moves the plan to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan, records the named insured's revocation of the plan's recurring payment authorization, and issues the plan's first invoice after the move on the move's day for the first installment not yet invoiced, keeping that installment's due date.

**What the move waits on.**

> A plan is moved off automatic draft only after the installment invoice that the payment most recently returned on it had paid is paid again in full.

> The first invoice after the move is figured only after the plan carries the switch down payment the move requires, a payment recorded toward the first installment not yet invoiced and linked to no invoice.

In the plan's records: while the installment invoice that the most recently returned payment had paid stands short of being paid again in full, the plan is not moved; and while no payment recorded toward the first installment not yet invoiced and linked to no invoice stands on the plan, the first invoice after the move is not figured.

**Outside these limits.** When the move is asked on any other plan or outside these limits, this schedule and neither wait above apply: the revocation is recorded under the base rule, the plan becomes the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan for its remaining installments, and its next invoice is billed as the base installment schedule states.

## The move function: `switch_to_direct_bill_b1ddc0c4`

**Capability.** `switch_to_direct_bill_b1ddc0c4` moves an installment payment plan that bills by automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan today, records the customer's revocation of the plan's recurring payment authorization, and issues the plan's first invoice after the move, dated today, charging that invoice's fee to the plan. On success the plan bills as the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan with no recurring payment method on file and one more plan switch counted; a revocation of the recurring authorization for the stated account or card stands on the plan, dated today, for the method the plan had on file; a new installment invoice stands for the stated installment with the stated due date, premium, fee, carried amount and minimum due; a matching installment fee charge is posted today; and the plan's account balance rises by the fee. The customer sees the new plan and the invoice on the account.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `switch_to_direct_bill_b1ddc0c4` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `billing_plan_id` | The reference number of the installment payment plan being moved, read from the plan record returned by the plan lookup. |
| `account_last4` | The last four digits of the bank account or card whose recurring authorization is revoked, exactly 4 digits as recorded on the plan's authorization. |
| `installment_number` | The number of the installment the first invoice bills: an integer of 0 or more, installments counted from 1 for the plan's earliest installment, no padding. |
| `due_date` | The date the invoiced amount is due, written YYYY-MM-DD as a calendar date with no time and no time zone. |
| `premium_amount` | The premium portion the invoice bills, in USD with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent. |
| `fee_amount` | The fee the invoice bills and the fee charge posted with it, in USD with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent. |
| `past_due_amount` | The amount carried onto the invoice from the plan's earlier billing, in USD with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; a credit held on the plan is written as a negative amount, and nothing carried as 0.00. |
| `minimum_due` | The amount due by the due date, in USD with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent. |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence stating the new plan name, the revocation reference number, the new invoice reference number, the installment fee charge reference number, the installment number, the due date (YYYY-MM-DD), the premium, fee, carried amount and minimum due (USD, two decimals) and the plan's account balance after the fee (USD, two decimals). The presence of the three reference numbers indicates the plan was moved, the authorization revoked and the invoice issued.
